summary: The search conditions above a list of records: labelled inputs, a search button and a clear.
not_for: One search field that narrows the rows as the reader types (the filter slot of collection.table.index), or a search form on a page of its own (references/real-screens.md, Form).

rules.rule: The conditions sit above the list they narrow, each an input under or beside its label.
The search button follows the last condition, with the clear beside it.
The first condition takes the focus when the screen opens.
After a search the conditions keep their values, the list shows the count of what matched, and a search that matches nothing shows the no-results state under them.
Eight conditions at most sit above a list; a search with more belongs to a screen of its own.

evidence.source: intra-mart Accel Platform UIデザインガイドライン(PC版), 一覧画面
evidence.says: The list screen puts a 検索 and a クリア button beside the search box above the list table, and deletes the checked rows after a confirmation that reads 選択したデータを削除します。よろしいですか.

evidence.source: intra-mart Accel Platform UIデザインガイドライン(PC版), ボタン
evidence.says: On a register or an edit screen the action buttons sit together at the foot, 登録 before 連続登録 and 更新 before 削除; the search button sits to the right of the input in the search-condition area.

evidence.source: intra-mart Accel Platform UIデザインガイドライン(PC版), 入力フォーム
evidence.says: Numbers are right-aligned and strings and dates left-aligned in text inputs; the first input the user fills takes the focus, the search box of a search screen included.

evidence.source: 弥生販売 サポート情報, 弥生販売のショートカットキー一覧
evidence.says: F12 登録 registers a slip or a ledger record, F9 削除 deletes it, F2 新規作成 clears the screen for a new one, F8 参照 opens the lookup of the field under the cursor, and Ctrl+F 検索 opens a screen where conditions are set to find slips.
